current: The broker's protocol listener runs under qip_fabricd::data_plane_limits: the transport's ServerLimits defaults (64 live connections, 16 of them handshaking, one request per connection) with the body ceiling raised to MAXIMUM_REQUEST_BYTES. A declaration over the ceiling is refused 413 before any body is buffered; a connection past the cap is answered 503 at the accept loop and never reaches a handler. Request memory is therefore bounded by the cap times the ceiling (64 x (8 MiB + 4 KiB)); the bound is a fixed connection pool with a fixed per-request ceiling, not a pooled buffer allocator.

notes: Text corrected 2026-10-17 by an independent grader (the previous text said the code was unwired or untested; it is wired, and the gap is narrower). Status unchanged. Mutation: admitting at max_concurrent + 1 in Server::serve leaves the fifth connection held, not refused, and the 503 assertion fails.
